Package org.geysermc.paletter

Record Class BlockExplanation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.geysermc.paletter.BlockExplanation
Record Components:
requested - the state asked for, as {name, states}
handle - its handle, or null if it has none in this palette
kind - how it was resolved for this palette's version
chain - the identifiers involved: the requested block, then the block it resolved to if that is another one
sent - the state that is sent to the client, or null if nothing fits (BlockExplanation.Kind.MISSING)
runtimeId - the runtime id of the sent state in this palette's network id mode, or -1
hashedId - the hashed network id of the sent state, whatever the palette's mode, or -1
@Experimental public record BlockExplanation(@NonNull org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap requested, @Nullable BedrockBlockState handle, @NonNull BlockExplanation.Kind kind, @NonNull List<String> chain, @Nullable org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap sent, int runtimeId, int hashedId) extends Record
What a palette does with a block state, for debugging: Palette.explain(NbtMap).
Since:
1.0.0
